svg.title: Ferret
svg.desc: Standing sable ferret with an elongated flexible trunk, short limbs, tapered muzzle, facial mask, and long tail. Biological basis: Ferrets have airway anatomy and respiratory responses useful for influenza and other respiratory-virus transmission studies, as well as auditory and veterinary research.
